spans.s:
1. एधतु, उस्, m. (for 2. see एन्ध् next page), Ved.
prosperity, happiness; a man; (उस्, उस्, उ), increased,
grown.

एधनीय or एधितव्य or एध्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
to be increased or enlarged.

एधमान, अस्, आ, अम्, prospering, increasing.
—एधमान-द्विष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, Ved. hating the pros-
perous, especially those rendered insolent by pros-
perity; (Sāy.) hating the impious who prosper.

एध, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. simple rt. इन्ध्), kindling,
one who kindles, cf. अग्न्य्-एध; (अस्), m. fuel, as
wood, grass, &c.; [cf. Gr. αἰθός]
—एधाहार
(एध-आह्˚), अस्, m. one who collects fuel.
